   1 class_name ProgressionSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Session, C_Progression, C_Checkpoint]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var session: C_Session = entity.get_component(C_Session)
  16 		var progress: C_Progression = entity.get_component(C_Progression)
  17 		var checkpoint: C_Checkpoint = entity.get_component(C_Checkpoint)
  18 		var actions: Array[String] = runtime.take_session_actions()
  19 		for action in entity.get_component(C_Input).ui_actions:
  20 			if not action in actions:
  21 				actions.append(action)
  22 		# Escape is mapped to both pause and ui_cancel; consume it once.
  23 		if "pause" in actions and "ui_cancel" in actions:
  24 			actions.erase("ui_cancel")
  25 		for action in actions:
  26 			match action:
  27 				"new_run":
  28 					_new_run(progress, checkpoint)
  29 					return
  30 				"continue_run":
  31 					var payload: Dictionary = runtime.save_repository.read_save(runtime.rooms, runtime.resources)
  32 					if payload.is_empty():
  33 						session.save_status = "failed"
  34 						session.message = runtime.save_repository.last_error + " · 可以开始新游戏"
  35 					else:
  36 						session.save_status = "pending" if OS.has_feature("web") else "saved"
  37 						session.message = "已读取检查点"
  38 						checkpoint.payload = payload
  39 						checkpoint.restore_requested = true
  40 				"retry":
  41 					if session.mode == "dead":
  42 						checkpoint.restore_requested = true
  43 				"pause", "map":
  44 					if session.mode == "playing":
  45 						session.mode = "paused" if action == "pause" else "map"
  46 						runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
  47 					elif session.mode in ["paused", "map"]:
  48 						session.mode = "playing"
  49 						runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
  50 				"resume", "ui_cancel":
  51 					if session.mode in ["paused", "map"]:
  52 						session.mode = "playing"
  53 						runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
  54 				"title":
  55 					session.mode = "title"
  56 					runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
  57 		if checkpoint.restore_requested:
  58 			checkpoint.restore_requested = false
  59 			var payload: Dictionary = runtime.save_repository.validate(checkpoint.payload, runtime.rooms, runtime.resources)
  60 			if payload.is_empty():
  61 				session.save_status = "failed"
  62 				session.message = runtime.save_repository.last_error + " · 可以开始新游戏"
  63 				return
  64 			progress.moonstep = payload.moonstep
  65 			progress.visited_rooms.assign(payload.visited_rooms)
  66 			progress.boss_defeated = payload.boss_defeated
  67 			progress.ending_seen = payload.ending_seen
  68 			checkpoint.checkpoint_id = payload.checkpoint_id
  69 			checkpoint.room_id = payload.room_id
  70 			checkpoint.spawn_id = payload.spawn_id
  71 			checkpoint.valid = true
  72 			runtime.player.get_component(C_Health).heal_requested = true
  73 			_reset_combat()
  74 			_transition(payload.room_id, payload.spawn_id, "restore")
  75 			return
  76 		if session.mode == "transition":
  77 			if session.transition.get("applied", false) and runtime.placements_complete():
  78 				session.loading = false
  79 				session.mode = "ending" if progress.ending_seen else "playing"
  80 				session.transition.clear()
  81 				if not session.room_id in progress.visited_rooms:
  82 					progress.visited_rooms.append(session.room_id)
  83 				_objective(progress)
  84 				runtime.announce_ready()
  85 			return
  86 		if session.mode != "playing":
  87 			return
  88 		if runtime.player.get_component(C_Health).dead:
  89 			session.mode = "dead"
  90 			session.message = "命运尚未终结 · 返回检查点再战"
  91 			runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
  92 			runtime.discard_transients()
  93 			_reset_combat()
  94 			return
  95 		for boss in runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Boss, C_Health]).enabled().execute():
  96 			if boss.enabled and boss.get_component(C_Health).dead and session.room_id == "house_throne":
  97 				progress.boss_defeated = true
  98 				progress.ending_seen = true
  99 				session.mode = "ending"
 100 				session.message = "绯月消散 · 赌城的诅咒已被斩断"
 101 				runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
 102 				runtime.discard_transients()
 103 				_reset_combat()
 104 				checkpoint.save_requested = true
 105 				return
 106 		for target in runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Interaction, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute():
 107 			if not target.enabled or target.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id != session.room_id:
 108 				continue
 109 			var interaction: C_Interaction = target.get_component(C_Interaction)
 110 			if not interaction.available or not interaction.requested:
 111 				continue
 112 			interaction.requested = false
 113 			match interaction.kind:
 114 				"door":
 115 					_transition(interaction.target_room, interaction.target_spawn, "door")
 116 				"relic":
 117 					if not progress.moonstep:
 118 						progress.moonstep = true
 119 						interaction.available = false
 120 						runtime.request_removal(target.id)
 121 						session.message = "获得月步！空中再按 Space/W 二段跳 · 返回大厅上层"
 122 						_objective(progress)
 123 				"checkpoint":
 124 					checkpoint.checkpoint_id = interaction.interaction_id
 125 					checkpoint.room_id = session.room_id
 126 					checkpoint.spawn_id = interaction.target_spawn
 127 					checkpoint.save_requested = true
 128 					runtime.player.get_component(C_Health).heal_requested = true
 129 			return
 130 
 131 func _new_run(progress: C_Progression, checkpoint: C_Checkpoint) -> void:
 132 	progress.moonstep = false
 133 	progress.visited_rooms.assign(["grand_lobby"])
 134 	progress.boss_defeated = false
 135 	progress.ending_seen = false
 136 	checkpoint.checkpoint_id = "start"
 137 	checkpoint.room_id = "grand_lobby"
 138 	checkpoint.spawn_id = "start"
 139 	checkpoint.valid = true
 140 	checkpoint.restore_requested = false
 141 	checkpoint.save_requested = false
 142 	checkpoint.payload = {"version": 1, "checkpoint_id": "start", "room_id": "grand_lobby", "spawn_id": "start", "moonstep": false, "visited_rooms": ["grand_lobby"], "boss_defeated": false, "ending_seen": false}
 143 	runtime.session.save_status = "none"
 144 	runtime.session.message = "前往轮盘钟楼寻找月步"
 145 	runtime.player.get_component(C_Health).heal_requested = true
 146 	_reset_combat()
 147 	_transition("grand_lobby", "start", "new_run")
 148 
 149 func _transition(room_id: String, spawn_id: String, reason: String) -> void:
 150 	var room: Dictionary = runtime.rooms.load_room(room_id, runtime.resources)
 151 	if room.is_empty() or not room.spawns.has(spawn_id):
 152 		runtime.session.message = "无法前往未知地点"
 153 		return
 154 	runtime.session.mode = "transition"
 155 	runtime.session.loading = true
 156 	runtime.session.transition = {"room_id": room_id, "spawn_id": spawn_id, "reason": reason, "applied": false}
 157 	runtime.clear_gameplay_input()
 158 	_reset_combat()
 159 	runtime.schedule_flush()
 160 
 161 func _reset_combat() -> void:
 162 	for actor in runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Combat]).enabled().execute():
 163 		if not actor.enabled:
 164 			continue
 165 		var combat: C_Combat = actor.get_component(C_Combat)
 166 		combat.state = "idle"
 167 		combat.time_left = 0.0
 168 		combat.requested_attack = ""
 169 		combat.dodge_invulnerable = false
 170 		combat.sword_cooldown = 0.0
 171 		combat.card_cooldown = 0.0
 172 		combat.dodge_cooldown = 0.0
 173 		combat.energy = combat.max_energy
 174 		var boss: C_Boss = actor.get_component(C_Boss)
 175 		if boss != null:
 176 			boss.arena_active = false
 177 			boss.state = "idle"
 178 			boss.time_left = 1.2
 179 
 180 func _objective(progress: C_Progression) -> void:
 181 	runtime.session.objective = "前往轮盘钟楼寻找月步" if not progress.moonstep else "用二段跳登上大厅高台，前往庄家王座"
 182 	if runtime.session.room_id == "quiet_save_room":
 183 		runtime.session.objective = "在神龛恢复生命并存档，再进入王座"
 184 	elif runtime.session.room_id == "house_throne":
 185 		runtime.session.objective = "看清预警，闪避卡牌与落掌，击败皇家庄家"
